Subject: Norvell Table & Tap Submission

Hi Avery,

Thanks for the submission on Norvell Table & Tap. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need to move forward.

However, I do need to refer this to our senior underwriting team before providing a quote. The five-year loss history shows incurred losses exceeding $250K, which is above my binding authority.

I'll present this internally and get back to you within 2-3 business days with either our terms or any additional questions. If our appetite doesn't align after review, I'd recommend reaching out to a surplus lines market that specializes in higher-loss hospitality risks.

I'll be in touch soon!

Best,
[Underwriter name]
